newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-PUMAS NAME TWICKENHAM SIDE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-PUMAS NAME TWICKENHAM SIDE.

text.p: Argentina will field three survivors from the ill-fated Pumas side hammered 51-0 at Twickenham six years ago when they face England in Saturday's end-of-tour test.

With Federico Mendez unavailable for the tour after signing to play English club rugby for Bath, Carlos Promanzio wins a fifth cap at hooker amongst five changes from the team who lost 44-21 at home to the Springboks in the second test last month.
French-based Mauricio Reggiardo reinforces the front-row, Pablo Bouza is at number eight, Gonzalo Quesada plays fly-half and Gonzalo Camardon is on the right wing.
Camardon made his international debut at scrum-half at Twickenham in 1990, the Pumas' last visit. Locks Pedro Sporleder and German Llanes also reappear.

Team: 15-Ezequiel Jurado; 14-Gonzalo Camardon, 13-Eduardo Simone, 12-Lisandro Arbizu (captain), 11-Diego Albanese; 10-Gonzalo Quesada, 9-Nicolas Miranda; 8-Pablo Bouza, 7-Pablo Camerlinckx, 6-Rolando Martin, 5-German Llanes, 4-Pedro Sporleder, 3-Mauricio Reggiardo, 2-Carlos Promanzio, 1-Roberto Grau.
